name: Mason
source:
With drool-worthy, model good-looks, Mason is extremely shy and easily flustered, rather than full of himself. It’s quite the deadly combination, especially if you get to know him enough to see his inner passion! Watch out! This beautiful man with his adorable blushing cheeks might be more devious…and dangerous than meets the eye!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.busaffair]Google Play[/url]]
